fact: IIEP-UNESCO, reporting on work in Niger's schools, inspectorates and education ministry before July 2023, states that school data (statistics, assessment results, reports) is entered manually, that some is archived only as averages by inspectorate and not for each school, that local actors often have no computer or electricity, and that the country has no reliable school database.
title: Improving Schools with Local Data, the Shawara Karatu initiative
